what: Between sections, a band of white clouds repeats endlessly sideways in the sky, one tile width (1440px) flowing straight right in 60 seconds — on phones (767px and below) one tile shrinks to 500px for the same 60 seconds. Overlapping two or three bands with different heights, lengths and shapes makes the clouds drift in layers. The clouds are mask shapes, so they are painted in the skin color (--kf-raised)

options.--fx-dur: Length of one flow cycle (css), default 60s
options.--fx-tile-narrow: Width of one set at 767px and below (css), default 500px
options.--fx-height: Band height (css), default 161px · on phones it shrinks proportionally (set separately with --fx-height-narrow)
options.--fx-mask: Cloud shape (css) — a url(image) or data: address, default is four low cloud clusters. A relative address in url() resolves from the fx.css location, so use data: or an absolute address
options.--fx-dir: When reverse, it flows to the left (css)
options.--fx-delay: Start delay (css), default 0s — give each layer a negative value so they are staggered from the start

from.where: index.html·about.html·news.html .cm-cloud (original .cloud — background 1440×161 repeat-x, @keyframes moveCloud background-position 0 → 1440px 60s linear infinite, moveCloudSp 500px on phone)

note: The original cloud image is not used, and the cloud shape is a newly drawn mask. The band sits behind the content (position absolute · z-index) and takes no pointer input
